text:
mira_csm: Quick sync — launching HelioHealth pilot. 20m to align owners, must-have success metrics, immediate blockers. Can we do 3pm PT?
devon_pm: 3pm works. I'll own acceptance criteria and final sign-off.
ashley_enable: I'll run the enablement + demo. Proposed must-haves: successful end-to-end request flow, embedding quality spot-checks, and Console visibility for ops.
ravi_se: I'll prep payload examples and a minimal load script. Also flag: they asked for 12-month retention + encryption-at-rest. Need clarity if pilot needs those.
nora_eng: SSO planned but not in pilot scope; estimate 10 business days. If they need earlier, we do token-based auth for pilot. I'll add a ticket.
mira_csm: Timeline idea: smoke by Thu EOD, internal verification Fri, customer pilot next Tue. Renewal note: renewal cycle in ~11 months; recommend capturing usage baseline early to surface value.
devon_pm: Actions: @ravi_se -> upload payloads to rw-helio/samples by tomorrow 10:00; @nora_eng -> update SSO ETA JIRA; @ashley_enable -> schedule 30m enablement + create a 5-question feedback form. I'll draft the acceptance checklist.
calendar-bot: Event created: "HelioHealth pilot kickoff" at 15:00 PT. Attendees: mira_csm, devon_pm, ashley_enable, ravi_se, nora_eng.
ravi_se: Uploaded samples and README to s3://rw-helio/samples. README includes curl + python snippet.
ashley_enable: Draft checklist posted to Confluence (wip). Plan: 15m demo + 15m Qs. Will circulate survey after.
mira_csm: Quick checklist (to formalize):
```
- e2e_smoke: pass
- p95_latency < 350ms
- embedding_spotcheck >= 0.9
- docs_shared: true
- week1_usage_reported
```
devon_pm: Also ensure monitoring alerts and cost baseline captured. If SSO delays, note as renewal risk for exec readout.
mira_csm: Setting daily 10m touch for first 4 business days. I'll send the 1-pager to the sponsor and capture any early feedback. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
